GOVERNMENT CLIENT · Odisha · IN
REFERENCE LETTER
To Whomsoever It May Concern
Ref: REF/23/14
Date: 31/03/2026
To Whomsoever It May Concern,
This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said
agency has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been
found satisfactory.
1. PROJECT DETAILS
Project Name
Sewerage Network — Odisha Pkg-17
Scope of Work
Sewerage Drainage works for Public Health Engineering Dept,
Odisha completed 2024.
Nature of Work
Sewerage Drainage
Contract Value
Rs. 3854.00 Lakh
Date of Completion
2024-03-27
Contractor's Role
Prime
2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT
Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was prompt and well documented, and . On that
basis the agency has been placed on our approved-agency list for this class of work.
Criterion
Rating
Observation
Adherence to Schedule
Excellent
Project delivered within contractual timeline
Quality of Work
Excellent
Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
Safety Record
Good
BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout
Responsiveness
Excellent
Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs
Financial Integrity
Good
Billing was accurate and supported by records
3. RECOMMENDATION
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost,
and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in
the future. This reference is valid for a period of High from the date of this letter.
4. VERIFICATION
For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter
is issued upon specific request of the contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future
engagements.
